newsitem.title: USA: Stage Stores to acquire C.R. Anthony.
newsitem.headline: Stage Stores to acquire C.R. Anthony.

text.p: Stage Stores Inc said on Wednesday it agreed definitively to acquire C.R. Anthony Co of Oklahoma City for $78 million in stock and the assumption of $15 million in debt.
Stage Stores said both boards have approved the $93 million deal, which will create a company with more than 550 stores in 23 states and annual sales over $1 billion.
Stage Stores will pay $8.00 per share for Anthony's shares, plus $0.01 per share for every $0.05 per share by which the average closing price of Stage Stores' common stock exceeds $20 per share.
C.R. Anthony shares closed Wednesday at 7-1/4, up 1/8 for the day. Their 52-week high was 8-1/8.
Stage shares closed at 20-1/2 on Wednesday, also up 1/8 for the day.
It was expected that most of Anthony's stores would be converted to Stage Stores' trade names of Stage and Bealls.
The deal still is subject to approval by Anthony stockholders.
